name: Sakurai Risa
source: The current student council president of Kohnodai Academy. She has perfect grades, is competent in every sport, looks absolutely stunning, and is even friends with basically everyone. Hiyama deems her to be as perfect as an anime superhero, but she’s just doing a good job of hiding her clumsier side. Tends to suppress her own feelings to serve the greater good. She has no clue how Hiyama feels about her and doesn’t have time for romance.
